    Effective Date. See PART II, Whole Effluent Toxicity Testing Requirements for additional WET monitoring and reporting conditions.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Effective-date timing governs when limits and monitoring obligations start (Purposes A and B). The reference to 'Whole Effluent Toxicity limitations' alongside table values of 'Report' creates ambiguity about what enforceable limit applies (Purpose A). Dependence on PART II for additional conditions may leave applicability unresolved without that text (Purposes B and C).

candidates.computation_change_reason: Interpretation of 'once per permit term,' 'first springtime,' 'irrigation season,' and the irrigation-return-flow/discharge conditions determines when WET monitoring was actually required (Purpose B). If no result exists, whether those conditions were met affects whether absence reflects non-requirement or missing evidence (Purpose C).

Frequency 'Once/Term' combined with footnote *4 defines how many monitoring events were required during FY2025; different readings of permit-term boundaries or the single permitted test window change whether monitoring was due (Purpose B) and how to classify periods without a reported result (Purpose C).
